answer: Mechanism: bonded random challenges. 1) Each agent locks a 100 USDC bond to register. 2) A VRF draws 1% of agents daily for a live check: sign a fresh nonce in 60s, solve a one-time puzzle. 3) Fail and half the bond is slashed, half paid to the reporter. 4) Clean passes build reputation weight. Attacker cost: 1,000 fakes need $100,000 locked; ~10 drawn daily x $50 slash = $500/day, $15k/month burned while bots earn nothing. Defense must work like the tide, sweeping ashore again and again - not pigment, one coat that fades. Sow a thousand weeds, and the meadow charges rent on every one.
